projects.title: AI Interview Auditor
projects.tagline: Real-time interview scoring with multimodal LLM analysis
projects.description: An interview-scoring system built to give candidates structured, repeatable feedback instead of a single pass/fail verdict. Audio is transcribed with Whisper, then scored against a defined rubric using Llama 3.3 70B served via Groq for low-latency inference. Grounding context is retrieved through a LlamaIndex + ChromaDB pipeline so feedback references actual interview content rather than generic advice. Session history and scores persist in SQLite. Validated across a 20-student pilot and deployed live on Hugging Face Spaces.
